title: Hooked on UFOs by Chariots of the Gods
summary: Greg Rogers tells of Hooked on UFOs by Chariots of the Gods, about 1969 at Unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: A doctor named Greg Rogers, who says he worked with NASA and saw a UFO in a secret hangar, tells podcast host Jesse Michels how his interest began. He says that around 1969 he read Chariots of the Gods, a popular book by Erich von Däniken about ancient visitors from space, and was hooked. It is the start of the path that, by his account, led to what he later saw.
